d.d: An ethnic group of Liberia and Sierra Leone.
The Niger-Congo language of the Vai people of Liberia and Sierra Leone.

To lower or “dip” a carried flag or banner in a salute by a forward reducing of the angle of the pike/flagstaff with respect to the ground; in extreme instances, as when saluting a monarch, both the banner and the finial of the pike are allowed to rest upon the ground.
Overly proud of oneself, especially concerning appearance; having a high opinion of one's own accomplishments with slight reason.
Having no real substance, value, or importance; empty; void; worthless; unsatisfying.
Boastful, unwarranted pride in one's accomplishments or qualities.
To boast; to act in a vain manner.
In a vain pursuit; to no avail.
d.x: She searched vainly for her reflection in the shattered mirror.

d.d: With a vain attitude; in a self-approving manner.
d.x: She stared vainly at her reflection in the mirror.
